newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers firm on higher swaps quotes.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers firm on higher swaps quotes.

text.p: Singapore bunker levels on Tuesday rose on higher swaps quotes as sellers anticipate cargo levels to rise on fresh buying interest, traders said.
Swaps quotes have risen about a dollar from Monday and bunker sellers have moved offers upwards, traders said.
Bunker 380-cst quotes have risen to around $2 per tonne from Monday, indicated at between $95-$97 per tonne. Cst 180 was quoted at $102-$10, over $2 higher from Monday.
One trader said demand remained average.
Gas oil prices were quoted around $215 per tonne and MDO at $195. --Singapore Newsroom (+65-870 3082)
